features.favorites: Stable favorite-first ordering of currently approved catalog only; personal account-separated slugs; shared-session memory only.
features.problem_report: Native WebView overflow menu; approved IT Hilfe GET form with application name in Subject and Body; never submits a ticket automatically.
features.notice_inbox: Bell merges current announcements with document and helpdesk event history; Android dismissal acknowledges badges but retains history; server cancellation removes the event.

security_and_limits.history: At most 100 document/helpdesk events for 14 days; identifiers and validated ticket/article IDs only on disk, no titles or messages.
security_and_limits.summaries: Memory-only, fetched on demand through existing signed notification-detail endpoint; server event expiry can require fallback to approved application.
security_and_limits.local_lock: Clears in-memory content; metadata remains for the same session after unlock.
security_and_limits.logout_or_offboarding: Existing UnreadNotificationStore.clearAll now also clears notice metadata; profile reset, lost device credential and central DeviceSecurityLock cleanup also clear application favorites.
security_and_limits.authorization: Current catalog checked before displaying or opening events; existing protected-action/device/session checks retained; documents excluded for shared mode.
security_and_limits.background_work: No new timer, worker or background connection; summaries requested only when inbox is opened/refreshed.
security_and_limits.backup: Existing cloud/device-transfer sharedpref exclusions cover new metadata preferences.

rollback: OTA remains unchanged. Revert scoped app changes to previous commit 6857d9823bfda52b2a0ddb922ef0c1c36387c5d1 and rebuild with production signer plus a higher versionCode for an in-place rollback; Android release downgrades should not be assumed to preserve data.
remaining_acceptance: Final bell icon visual confirmation after last local update; favorite ordering/reload, inbox entry and contextual report have been accepted on the phone.
Real document/ticket event followed by Android dismissal and exact approved navigation from history.
No actual ticket, mail or synthetic production push created during this turn.
wake_setting: 0 before test; temporary wake enabled for UI checks; restored to 0 after final installation and read back successfully
